stateDefinitions.operational-baseline: Established Tier 2 operation; no fresh approval, but health and rollback checks apply.
stateDefinitions.support-active: Established reversible support service; action-specific provenance checks apply.
stateDefinitions.disabled-by-directive: No live execution until the named directive owner lifts the hold.
stateDefinitions.disabled-after-incident: No live execution until containment evidence, independent review, and explicit approval exist.
stateDefinitions.shadow-paused: Tier 0 work is open; another live shadow run waits for the named evidence conditions.
stateDefinitions.quarantined: Source may be inspected locally but may not be synced, executed, committed for promotion, or deployed.
stateDefinitions.approved-production: Tier 3 production state backed by active scoped approvals, independent review, rollback, stop conditions, and retained evidence.

deniedActions: silently add a held subsystem to startup.js
rollback: Stop the affected core process or use the documented clean startup recovery after preserving evidence.
subsystems.nextSafeAction: Continue established core operation and local MCP improvements in a non-synced worktree.

deniedActions: treat a watched-source edit as purely local
healthEvidence: source identity for any live action
rollback: Stop using the connector for promotion; preserve local evidence and use the non-synced worktree.
subsystems.nextSafeAction: Keep governance edits disjoint from WATCHED_FILES.

conditionsToAdvance: Exact source intended for the run is committed or hash-attested and verified in-game.
The shadow script explicitly opens a correctly sized tail or otherwise provides agreed visual evidence.
mcp_formulas_shadow.txt is pulled locally, parsed, and tied to the run/source identity.
The bounded command, timeout, output retention, stop condition, and rollback pass the Tier 1 action gate.
rollback: Kill only mcp_formulas_shadow.js; production MCP selection remains untouched.
subsystems.nextSafeAction: Implement/test explicit tail opening locally, then retrieve and attest the existing output.

deniedActions: run the stock panel during the present stability baseline
conditionsToAdvance: Ken lifts the current avoid-stock-market hold.
subsystems.nextSafeAction: Leave the read-only source untouched and continue non-stock work.

allowedActions: local static inspection of the quarantined file
conditionsToAdvance: Ken issues a narrow capital-deployment approval with a cash cap, instruments, duration, and stop-loss.
Independent review returns ADOPT or REVISE with every condition satisfied.
Dry-run evidence, rollback, and retained order audit trail pass.
rollback: Do not launch; if found running, stop only mcp_stock_trader.js and retain process/order evidence.
subsystems.nextSafeAction: Continue read-only analysis; seek a separate cleanup decision before deleting or moving the untracked source.

allowedActions: incident analysis in a non-synced worktree
conditionsToAdvance: A bounded CPU/RAM/move-time budget and duplicate-process guard are independently reviewed.
A short live canary has explicit stop conditions and Ken's approval.
Source identity is attested because ipvgo_logic.js is currently dirty in the synced checkout.
rollback: Kill both IPvGO player and HUD; preserve the last status and process list.
subsystems.nextSafeAction: Run only local tests/profiling in a non-synced worktree.

deniedActions: start or restart the Darknet swarm
conditionsToAdvance: Ken explicitly lifts the current hold and the start command/rollback are reconciled to the current architecture.
rollback: Use the documented Darknet-only kill path; do not restart automatically.
subsystems.nextSafeAction: Reconcile stale legacy plans and keep tests current without running the subsystem.

allowedActions: static design of a bounded cooldown
conditionsToAdvance: The share loop has an explicit bounded sleep/cooldown and passes local tests.
A bounded live canary, duplicate guard, stop command, and health budget are independently reviewed.
Ken explicitly approves re-enable after the stability incident.
rollback: Run the documented share-only stop path; confirm no scripts/share.js process remains.
subsystems.nextSafeAction: Continue the core MCP baseline without faction sharing.
